title: Umlawuli Owayefuna UbuThixo
intro: Umlawuli onamandla nozikhukhumezayo wayekholelwa ukuba akukho mntu umi ngaphezu kwetrone yakhe. Basukela iqela elalibaleka liwela amanzi amaninzi, kodwa bafika esiphelweni esimangalisayo. Ibali lalo kumkani liphinda-phinda kwiindawo ezininzi zeQuran, lisebenza njengesilumkiso kubo bonke.
clues: Ndandingumlawuli onamandla owayekholelwa ukuba akukho gunya lidlula elam kumazwe endandiwalawula.
Ndandinesazi esithembekileyo esigama linguHaman esasindinceda ekwenzeni imisebenzi emikhulu yokwakha.
Ndabiza izazi ezilungileyo zelizwe lam ukuze zindichase imiqondiso yesithunywa esindichasayo.
Andivumanga ukuvumela abantu ababengamakhoboka kubukumkani bam bahambe, nangona kukho izibetho nezilumkiso ezicacileyo.
Ndawasukela ndawanqumla ulwandle olukhulu nomkhosi wam wonke neenqwelo zokulwa.
Lolo lwandle lundigubungele mna nemikhosi yam, lwasirhaxa sonke, ngelixa bona bewela ngokukhuselekileyo.

arabic: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
verse: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy. (51:40)
